label: copy phase, mid-sequence (recall 3-4, >=3 outputs left) re-input of n/g/p/f/z
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original inputs or the delimiter. Never fires on the first occurrence of a token (in_first=0 always), because in the copy phase the input is the fed-back earlier output. Concentrated at recall_idx 3-4 (about 87% of mass) in long sequences (L 8-9 give about 80% of mass), i.e. middle copy positions with 3 or more outputs still to go. Strongly token-selective on the fed-back input: n, g, p, f, z (about 77% of mass), weaker for r, j, s. The strongest activations are recall_idx 3 in L=8-9 sequences with input g/n/p/f. There is a smaller separate tail at the last two copy steps of L=9 sequences (t=16-17, about 7% of mass). Precision is limited because the same token and position often do not fire, so magnitude also depends on context not captured here (the upcoming output h/i/v raises the rate). No activity in the original phase.
